# Shagun Khemka

> Senior Software Engineer (Backend) at JioHotstar, based in Mumbai, India. Builds high-scale subscription platforms and production AI systems: LLM routing, evals and cost-aware inference.

Open to Lead / Staff backend, platform and AI-infrastructure roles. Contact: shagun.khemka60@gmail.com

## Experience
- JioHotstar, Senior Software Engineer, Backend (2024–now): subscriptions platform for 280M+ users; architected the P0 entitlement read path at ~50K RPS; re-architected purchase and upgrade flows (~20% revenue growth, Astral Team Award 2026); helped build the JioCinema entitlement service serving user attributes to core services (Go, Spanner, Redis; Gangstar of the Quarter team award 2024); led the migration of 14M+ JioCinema subscribers; automated the Disney+ Hotstar to Disney+ plan migration (6K+ naming and config changes across 1K+ plans in 27 countries, published and synced to the subscriptions service), cutting ~3 hours of manual launch-day work to under 15 minutes including verification; a teammate later reused it to disable plans in the 23 markets handed over to Disney; migrated a service to AWS Graviton + Java 21 (~20% compute savings) and packaged the playbook as Claude and Codex agent skills for team-wide self-serve migrations; led a SEV-1 response at JioCinema when Akamai blocked ~200K payment-gateway renewal webhooks, restoring ~70K renewal statuses within 3 hours by fixing the reconciliation cron, which was calling the wrong status-check API; on-call for IPL at 30M+ concurrent viewers; backend hiring panelist for LLD and HLD (system design) rounds (20+ interviews); ran Go and Spanner knowledge-sharing sessions (including a Tech Tuesday talk on Spanner) that got 3 teammates contributing independently.
- FamPay (YC S19), Software Engineer, Backend (2020–2024): joined as the second backend engineer; led a team of four on the FamCard platform (5M+ cards); architected the gift card platform (₹60 Cr+ cumulative GMV); products behind ~60% of monthly revenue; conducted 30+ interviews, onboarded new engineers and mentored 5+ into full-time roles.
- Instamojo, Software Engineer, Backend (2019–2020): merchant onboarding automation (~25% fewer KYC resubmissions) and reseller product ingestion (~15K products in the first month); converted from intern to full-time (PPO).

## Projects
- Document extraction platform: LLM pipeline for a logistics ERP software company. Field-level evals across Claude, GPT, Gemini, Qwen, Mistral and Sarvam choose the production model; Gemini 3.8 Flash and GPT-6 Luna run in production with a phased per-tenant rollout. On the latest eval GPT-6 Luna is 8x cheaper and ~45% faster than Gemini Flash, with total amount, invoice value and actual weight at 100%.
- ConsumerBuddy (https://consumerbuddy.in): AI drafting of consumer-court complaints in India (private beta). Claude vision describes uploaded evidence, a web-search tool finds opposite-party details, per-cohort model routing with pinned model plans, and a per-call INR cost ledger with usage caps.
